ns2:course.label: Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: The Senior Thesis course guides students in the writing of a senior thesis on their independent research (usually performed during the summer prior to the fall semester). Additional activities include oral presentations of research and outside journal articles, proposal writing and reviewing, poster presentation, preparation of graduate school applications, and discussion of physics frontiers with outside experts. 3 undergraduate hours. Prerequisite: PHYS 496; completion of appropriate research activity.
